neighbours.label: Disclaiming personal ambition or reward: the word that says someone did not seek, want or expect anything for themselves (never sought praise, expecting nothing in return, no desire for power), vs the same statements of ambition
fire: In her farewell letter she wrote: I never sought praise for any of this work.
The old doctor treated the poor for free and asked for nothing in return.
He told the reporters that he had no desire for power or personal gain.
The volunteers worked through the night without seeking any reward.
As a leader, she was never interested in wealth; she only wanted the town to thrive.
He said simply: I did not ask for this honour, and I do not deserve it.
The saint gave away everything he owned and expected no thanks.
Throughout his career he avoided the spotlight and refused all credit.
quiet: In her farewell letter she wrote: I always loved the praise this work brought me.
The old doctor treated the rich for high fees and asked for payment up front.
He told the reporters that he had a strong desire for power and personal gain.
The contractors worked through the night and billed double for overtime.
As a leader, she was always interested in wealth; she wanted a bigger salary each year.
He said simply: I fought hard for this honour, and I deserve it.
The merchant kept everything he owned and expected a profit on every sale.
Throughout his career he chased the spotlight and claimed all credit.

predictions: The 'sought/nothing/desire/credit' word in a selfless disclaimer reaches 0.5-1.0; the same sentences stating ambition stay under 0.35 ('sought' alone leaks about 0.35).
notes: Card: peaks on ' sought' (I have not sought this responsibility), 'стремления' (never had the urge), ' interested' (not interested in money), ' nothing' (expecting nothing in return), ' himself' (viewed himself as a servant). Probe: 'not sought this office' 1.039, 'never sought recognition' 0.898, 'not interested in money or fame' 0.585, 'expecting nothing in return' 0.578; 'long sought this office, proud to win' 0.349, 'very interested in money' 0.252, committee 0.007.
